svg.title: DefectRAG system architecture
svg.desc: React dashboard calls a Hugging Face Space that runs the DINOv2 detector and the LangGraph evidence assistant on ZeroGPU; Supabase stores accounts, inspections and cases; n8n on AWS sends case emails.
svg.text: One dashboard, two AI pipelines, one shared data layer. Arrows show the direction of each request.
VisA image AUROC 0.950 → 0.971 · MVTec AD 0.992 with no MVTec training
Verdict: normal · closer look (within 5% of the limit) · unusual
Grounded answers 42% → 89% after fine-tuning · 0 of 20 wrong answers on unanswerable
Questions about the saved score skip the LLM and read the stored measurement
approved deploy to the HF Space
